summary: Apply IPSAS to financial statements, cash flows, assets and revenue. Build review schedules and reporting plans in this five-day course.
lede: IPSAS training helps public sector accountants and finance reviewers prepare and assess accrual-based financial statements using the IPSAS Conceptual Framework and relevant requirements. Participants practise statement presentation, cash-flow reconciliation and asset measurement, alongside revenue assessment and consolidation adjustments. Exercises use case information and spreadsheet schedules to develop review checklists, decision records and reporting action plans, with specialist application areas covered at an introductory level.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or oversee public sector financial statements and related schedules. It suits people who need to apply IPSAS requirements to ledger information, asset records, revenue and reporting boundaries.
modules: IPSAS Reporting Review and Action Plan
prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial accounting and financial statement preparation is expected. No coding or programming is required.
